scope_choices: Table values were transcribed from the rendered tables. The local PDF has 11 physical pages; the prior 10-page scope was incomplete.
The paper has no limitations section, no repeated runs and no intervals.
The legacy row was read from the root workbook (read only). Saved API drafts for B058 were not opened.
Schema validity and quote occurrence do not establish semantic correctness. One reviewer pass, no independent human review.

Phase E repair verified all 11 extracted PDF pages (p. 11 contains References 32-36) and downgraded capability_assessments from L2 to not_world_model because the Godot transition simulator uses fixed rules (dynamics.learned_hybrid is partial).

Targeted gap review 2026-11-22: local PDF has 11 physical pages, SHA256 verified against registry. Newly inspected pages and visuals are recorded in the accompanying coverage patch. Prior review scope statements superseded only where this pass actually inspected the source; no independent human review or replication.
Supplementary A-E referenced in the text are not embedded in the local PDF and remain unavailable for this review.
